channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: American warship fires five inch main gun off Morroco
item.description: U.S. Navy destroyer USS Paul Ignatius has conducted a live firing of its Mk 45 five-inch gun during a naval surface fire support drill in the Atlantic Ocean, according to information released by the service. The post American warship fires five inch main gun off Morroco first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK developing urgent plan for conflict, minister says
item.description: The UK is drawing up new preparations for a potential major conflict, according to Armed Forces Minister Al Carns, in remarks reported by Sky News. The post UK developing urgent plan for conflict, minister says first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: The massive transformation underway at Babcock
item.description: Rosyth is going through a profound industrial shift. Digital engineering, early systems integration and lifetime control are redefining how warships are built and sustained. The change is structural, with implications far beyond a single programme. The post The massive transformation underway at Babcock first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Leonard brands Ferguson Marine employee payment ‘con trick’
item.description: The Public Audit Committee’s report into Ferguson Marine, said Richard Leonard MSP, had uncovered an extraordinary secondment arrangement involving a senior employee and more than £144,000 in public funds. The post Leonard brands Ferguson Marine employee payment ‘con trick’ first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Forbes backs £14.2m Ferguson Marine funding amendment
item.description: The Scottish Government has reaffirmed its commitment to invest up to £14.2 million in modernising Ferguson Marine, with Deputy First Minister Kate Forbes confirming her support. The post Forbes backs £14.2m Ferguson Marine funding amendment first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain’s new ‘Nightfall’ ballistic missile project underway
item.description: Britain has launched 'Project Nightfall' for a cost effective, ground launched ballistic missile with a range greater than 500 kilometres, capable of operating in high threat and contested environments. The post Britain’s new ‘Nightfall’ ballistic missile project underway first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Think tank urges unified maritime strategy for UK defence
item.description: A new memorandum published in Britain’s World by the Council on Geostrategy examines whether the UK’s latest defence strategies are sufficiently aligned to deliver the maritime capability they envisage. The post Think tank urges unified maritime strategy for UK defence first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK plans £8bn tactical battlefield comms framework
item.description: The UK is preparing to launch a major long term procurement programme for military tactical comms, with a newly updated pipeline notice outlining plans for a framework worth up to £8 billion. The post UK plans £8bn tactical battlefield comms framework first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MOD seeks suppliers for RAF air traffic control simulators
item.description: The Ministry of Defence is preparing to procure a new generation of air traffic control visual simulators for use across Royal Air Force sites, according to a newly published tender notice. The post MOD seeks suppliers for RAF air traffic control simulators first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Ukrainian interceptor drones strained as air war intensifies
item.description: A new report warns that Russia’s air campaign against Ukraine shows no sign of easing, despite improvements in interception rates, with sustained pressure on energy infrastructure, cities and civilians continuing to define the conflict. The post Ukrainian interceptor drones strained as air war intensifies first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
